title: Two-step answer emission
statement: Let $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, and let $H$ be the associated host machine with $4+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P$ work tapes and state set $	ext{Fin}(2)$, where $k_V,k_I,k_P$ are the respective numbers of work tapes. For a Boolean input word $x$, a Boolean value $b$, and a configuration $c$ of $H$ on input $x$ whose state is $0$, map the state of $c$ to the answer phase for $b$ and run $H$ for two steps. The resulting configuration is halted, its output is the output of $c$ followed by $b$, and at every time $r\leq 2$ its work-tape head positions equal those of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ are finite Boolean Turing machines
$c$ is a configuration of the associated host machine on input $x$
